notes.title: We slaughtered some bugs and made improvements!!
notes.content:
We are glad to announce, that there are improvements, and we have made a bloody mess of annoying bugs!

[list]
[*] Add autopause when changing app context
[*] Adjust toaster aiming
[*] Change Level1 shading
[*] Update IO system
[*] Fix Cinematic and Credits ending when changing app context
[*] Fix occasional short performance drops when switching background music
[*] Fix occasional performance drops when fighting Unikorn boss
[*] Fix too many mob hug audio entities causing audio temporal audio glitches
[*] Fix Level1 falling behind free hugs sign
[*] Remove ability to rocketjump in Unikorn base
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 2707
notes.content:
It has been a week after the release - yeey! A lot of streams covering our little game were watched, a lot of feedback, suggestions were read during this time - and here we have a wild patch :) Enjoy!

Changes
[list]
[*] Chilli hands always are up now! NYAARGH!
[*] Fix Cannon ammo UI display during weapon switching while reloading
[*] Fix watermelon walk animation and add new attack animation
[*] Several Level3 AI navigation updates
[*] Unikorn tentacle base rotates slower
[*] Fix Retry not working if retrying more than once in Arena mode
[*] Fix Rocket launcher stuck loading animation if no ammo to load and force reload is triggered
[/list]

NYAARGH! tribe

notes.title: Patch 2507
notes.content:
It has been really fun to watch streams, read reviews and feedback.  We are updating our small little game :)
In case You have feedback, suggestions or just want to chitchat - feel free to join our Discord (check game main menu)!

Changes:
[list]
[*] Arena Leaderboard information about top players
[*] Main menu Leaderboard information about each of Arena top players
[*] Fix weapon ammo overflow bug
[*] Fix Level2 tower nonstop action music
[*] Remove Level2 bananas on checkpoint spawn point when resuming
[*] Fix Level3 temple entrance collider
[*] Fix Level3 caves occlusion
[*] Fix Level3 caves occlusion
[*] Fix Cannon angle
[*] Other bug fixes and stuff
[/list]

NYAARGH! tribe

notes.title: Patch 2307
notes.content:
Since last Friday with the release of the game, we been watching hours of game footage You shared over YouTube and reading your feedback messages. Thank you so much for helping us see where those little bugs are! 
We have been working on an update which has lots of bug fixes and performance updates. We will still be working on out little game and help you enjoy it even more.

Changelist:
[list]
[*]  Lots of small bug fixes
[*]  Small story level1, level2 and 3 updates 
[*]  Nerfed Banana
[*]  Nerfed Toaster
[*]  Shotgun alternative attack triggers quick shot while reloading 
[*]  Fixed Resolution lookup on non 60Hz displays
[*]  Fix Mac black screen issue when using non native resolution
[/list]

NYAARGH! tribe
